name: unique
expr: us = unique(x); ust = unique(x, 'stable'); [u, ia, ic] = unique([3 1 4 1 5], 'stable'); [cu, cia, cic] = unique(z); czs = unique(z, 'stable'); ct = unique([2+0i -2 1i -1i 2]);
comment: Sig: u = unique(x); u = unique(x,'stable'); [u,ia,ic] = unique(x,setOrder). Covers: default 'sorted' (ascending), 'stable' (first-occurrence order, no sort), three-output 'stable' index vectors (ia into x, ic into u). COMPLEX unique orders by magnitude |z| then phase angle arg(z), dedup by exact equality: unique([3+4i 1 3+4i 5i])=[1 3+4i 5i] ia=[2;1;4] ic=[2;1;2;3]; 'stable' keeps first-occurrence; unique([2 -2 1i -1i 2])=[-1i 1i 2 -2].
